title: InputGroup
wrapsNative: HStack around a TextField with .textFieldStyle(.plain), in a RoundedRectangle border from the theme
summary: A recipe, not a component: text, a unit or a button attached to a standard TextField inside one bordered box.
whenToUse: For a field with a fixed prefix or suffix ("https://", "kg") or one attached action (copy, clear, generate).
whenNotToUse: For a plain labelled field, use MonarchTextField. For a number with a unit, give MonarchNumberInput a format such as .percent or .currency instead of a suffix. For search, use the searchable modifier.
api: HStack { Text(prefix); TextField(label, text: $text).textFieldStyle(.plain); MonarchButton(title, variant: .ghost, size: .sm) { … } }

states.name: disabled
states.description: Apply disabled(_:) to the HStack; the field and the button follow it.

states.name: error
states.description: Stroke the border with the danger colour and put the message under the box, as MonarchTextField does.

appearance: The box takes the surface fill, the input border and the 8-point corner from the theme, so it matches MonarchTextField. The attached text uses the muted text colour.
platformNotes: The parity plan says this is covered by prefix, suffix, leading and trailing slots of MonarchTextField. MonarchTextField has no such slots today, so the recipe composes the standard TextField with MonarchButton directly and repeats the field's border. If the slots are added, this entry should point at them. The web's InputGroup, InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton are three components; on iOS they are the children of one HStack, in reading order, and leading and trailing follow the layout direction without an align option.
accessibility: The TextField keeps its own label; the attached text is separate static text that VoiceOver reads before or after the field. Hide it with accessibilityHidden when it repeats the label.
The attached button is a MonarchButton with its own title and a 44-point touch target.
The box is at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: At the largest text sizes a long prefix leaves little room for the field; keep attached text to a few characters.
The recipe does not draw a focus ring; add monarchFocusRing with @FocusState if the screen is used with a hardware keyboard.

examples.title: URL prefix in a Field
examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1_5) {
    Text({{label}}).monarchTextStyle(.label).foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textDefault)
    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.space2) {
        Text({{prefix}})
            .monarchTextStyle(.body)
            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
        TextField({{label}}, text: $address, prompt: Text({{placeholder}}))
            .textFieldStyle(.plain)
            .monarchTextStyle(.body)
    }
    .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.space3)
    .frame(minHeight: MonarchAccessibility.minimumHitTarget)
    .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md).fill(theme.colors.bgSurface))
    .overlay(
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md)
            .strokeBorder(theme.colors.borderInput, lineWidth: theme.spacing.px)
    )
    Text({{description}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
}
examples.setupTemplate:
@Environment(\.monarchTheme) private var theme
@State private var address = ""
examples.setup:
@Environment(\.monarchTheme) private var theme
@State private var address = ""
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1_5) {
    Text("Website").monarchTextStyle(.label).foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textDefault)
    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.space2) {
        Text("https://")
            .monarchTextStyle(.body)
            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
        TextField("Website", text: $address, prompt: Text("example.com"))
            .textFieldStyle(.plain)
            .monarchTextStyle(.body)
    }
    .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.space3)
    .frame(minHeight: MonarchAccessibility.minimumHitTarget)
    .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md).fill(theme.colors.bgSurface))
    .overlay(
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md)
            .strokeBorder(theme.colors.borderInput, lineWidth: theme.spacing.px)
    )
    Text("Without the protocol.")
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
}
